classification: Concrete experiment specification for human policy decision; no approval or scientific execution
name: One gap-guarded correction cycle with sufficient offline solver time
trigger: Human asks whether work is stuck, which concrete experiment could move repair forward, and what approval is needed.
hypothesis: Retaining the two saved actual-gap tangent constraints in both the primary and interior problems can produce a finite step that reduces nonlinear mismatch while correcting those two actual normal-descent violations. This is unproven; the tangent constraints alone do not guarantee nonlinear success.

evidence.interpretation: The45-second total cap has not produced a current candidate. The earlier larger-budget solve did produce one at an older model origin. That motivates a bounded budget test, not a guarantee of convergence or repair.

existing_inputs.reuse_policy: Inherit already audited matrices/proofs by exact hash; no reassembly, target derivative recomputation, proof replay, or old/internal primal direction.

requested_policy_changes: Permit exactly one cold revisit of the terminal targeted-gap primary input; this is explicitly a retry exception, not a newly invented formulation.

Permit up to600seconds total for the primary stage and up to600seconds total for the conditional interior stage, including imports, hashing, loads, solve, return checks, independent audit and finalization; finite/model stage remains45seconds.

For these two stages only, certify optimality of the strengthened problem including the two actual-gap constraints. Retain every original primal constraint and its unchanged feasibility threshold, but do not require the added dual multipliers to be exactly zero or demand a separate optimum certificate for the original problem without those constraints. No returned multiplier may be edited.

stages.scope: One cold full-coordinate primary solve using the saved augmented input.
stages.problem: min t subject to the saved652531x78791 augmented system, all1366 original homogeneous equalities and all original bounds.
stages.initialization: Saved accepted nonlinear origin; no x0, saved basis, internal iterate or rejected point. One highs-ipm call with inherited options and only remaining420s allowance.
stages.acceptance: Successful complete finite raw return; unchanged primal and dual arrays; augmented primal/equality/bound/stationarity/absolute-gap<=1e-9, exact dual signs and zero infinite-bound multipliers; full-original primal/equality/bound<=1e-9; both target buffered slacks>=0; at least1% predicted merit reduction.
stages.failure: Stop whole cycle on timeout, missing point, failed audit, any gate failure or insufficient predicted progress. No alternate method, parameter change or retry.

stages.scope: Only after A passes: one fresh strict-interior solve that retains both actual-gap constraints.
stages.problem: Original490 interior with ceiling=(current_mu+new_primary_theta)/2, plus the same two gap constraints with eta coefficient zero. All original interval reserve rows and eta bounds[0,0.5] retained. Derived full shape837065x78791 must be independently verified.
stages.initialization: Cold solve. The primary direction is not decoded or used as a warm start. The new primary establishes only the recorded mismatch ceiling.
stages.acceptance: Unchanged finite raw point and raw marginals; full strengthened-system numerical KKT<=1e-9, exact dual signs; full-original primal checks; both target slacks>=0; exact unscaled positive interval clearance on all92267 intervals; independently verified trace.
stages.failure: Stop whole cycle on first failure. No dual correction, point editing, scaling, boundary repair or revalidation exception.

stages.scope: Only after B passes: one alpha1 finite encoding and fresh nonlinear-model evaluation plus independent audit.
stages.mechanics: Use the existing468/490 finite rules:205 binary64 drops and exact pivot203, exact endpoint sum, original load-rounding and interval reserves; no clipping, normalization, root rescue or alternate step.
stages.research_success: Encoding and independent audit pass; nonlinear phi decreases by at least1% from0.08605330623059242; both target actual signed rows>=0; no previously nonnegative actual kept-hard row becomes negative; worst actual kept-hard violation does not increase; existing auxiliary-domain and encoded-prediction/filter checks also pass.
stages.report_every_outcome: Full actual signed-row residuals, all seven physical consistency units, original bounds, normal and hover, fixed/inactive/load invariants, before/after target gaps, actual/predicted reduction and time/memory; report failures without selecting a failed point.
stages.admission: Research success alone is not motion admission. All inherited original nonlinear/mechanical/runtime/geometry gates remain before simulation. This cycle authorizes no simulation/PPO/holdout.
stages.failure: Any failure terminates this cycle. Preserve output and diagnostics; no smaller step, renewed solver call, altered tolerance or automatic next cycle.

resources.accounting: 600+600+45; each includes producer, independent audit, hashes/loads and finalization. No budget transfers between stages. Implementation/preparation time is separate and not scientific execution. Each stage requires an outer wall-clock watchdog as well as backend limits.

unchanged_requirements: Every original bound, trust radius, guard, row, numerical feasibility tolerance and exact finite encoding rule.
All physical success criteria and protection of all64 existing successes.
No current repair claim without all72 full20-second development trials; specified PPO and held-out evaluation and complete subminute video still required.
No simulation, PPO, holdout access, or extra cycle under this proposal.
required_implementation_before_launch: Create a new isolated versioned runner; do not change any completed experiment source/output.
Implement source-bound reuse of saved primary inputs, augmented rather than original-only optimum admission, and the interior augmentation; retain all original feasibility checks.
Implement and synthetically test the explicit fresh-nonlinear comparison rule, including new hard-row violations and both actual targets.
Freeze complete sources, input/runtime hashes, source review, independent input/return/finite audit, exact rational resource bounds and watchdogs. Never set launch_ready from this proposal alone.
Bind any human approval to this exact specification; check live workers and use one execution owner. Changes beyond this scope require fresh human steering.
disclosure: This is a reviewable experimental specification, not a completed execution/source freeze or repair. The new runner and independent audit adaptations must be completed and frozen before any scientific run. No existing approval is reused.
